description_en: Queries the details of one or more traces
description_zh: 获取多个调用链的详情
kebab_example: aliyun arms get-multiple-trace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --trace-ids ac1400a115951745017447033d0000 --start-time 1657692507000 --end-time 1663999380000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMultipleTrace

parameters.help_en: The start time of the trace. The value is a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 调用链路开始时间的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the trace ends. The value is a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 调用链路结束时间的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 查询分页的页码，从1开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page, the maximum value is 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页的查询数据条数，最大值1000
parameters.name: page_size
